lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense collection of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters is visible across the anterior and mid-lateral flank, arranged in multiple horizontal rows that increase in density towards the dorsal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs on the posterior section of the visible flank, forming a grid-like structural pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity pixels on the upper surface to lower-intensity pixels in the shadowed region immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, dark pixel cluster with low luminance is visible on the lower posterior section of the flank, ventral to the primary lateral ridges.
